triples.tail_surface: install a vacuum gauge in the suction port and a pressure gauge in the discharge port
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 在吸入口安装真空表并在排出口安装压力表
triples.evidence_text: If trouble does develop, one of the first steps toward finding the difficulty is to install a vacuum gauge in the suction port and a pressure gauge in the discharge port.

triples.tail_surface: Suction line is blocked by a stuck foot valve, stuck gate valve, or plugged strainer
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 吸入管路因底阀卡死、闸阀卡死或过滤器堵塞而阻塞
triples.evidence_text: VACUUM GAUGE - SUCTION PORT 1. High reading would indicate: a. Suction line is blocked by a stuck foot valve, stuck gate valve, or plugged strainer.

triples.evidence_text: VACUUM GAUGE - SUCTION PORT 1. High reading would indicate: ... b. Liquid is too viscous to flow through the piping.

triples.head_surface: Running the pump longer than one minute without liquid inside it
triples.head_canonical_zh: 泵内无液体运行超过一分钟
triples.tail_surface: damage the pump
triples.evidence_text: Running the pump longer than one minute without liquid inside it can damage the pump.

triples.tail_surface: stop the pump
triples.evidence_text: If liquid is not leaving the discharge port, stop the pump. Running the pump longer than one minute without liquid inside it can damage the pump.

triples.tail_surface: damage
triples.evidence_text: Pumping water, dirty or otherwise, can do more damage in a few minutes than months of normal service.

triples.tail_surface: Either remove the pump or run piping around it while flushing or testing
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 冲洗或试压时拆除泵或设置旁通管路
triples.evidence_text: Do not use the Viking pump to flush, pressure test or prove the system with water. Either remove the pump or run piping around it while flushing or testing. Pumping water, dirty or otherwise, can do more damage in a few minutes than months of normal service.

triples.tail_surface: loosen packing gland nuts so gland can be moved slightly by hand
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 松开填料压盖螺母使压盖可手动微移
triples.evidence_text: For packed pumps, loosen packing gland nuts so gland can be moved slightly by hand.

triples.tail_surface: Adjust gland to reduce leakage only after pump has run long enough to reach constant temperature
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 泵运行至恒温后调整压盖以减少泄漏
triples.evidence_text: Adjust gland to reduce leakage only after pump has run long enough to reach constant temperature.
